name: Tablet PC Production Line Solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for tablet PC manufacturers, covering display assembly, battery installation, motherboard assembly, shell lamination, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The tablet PC production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for consumer electronics manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including touch screen assembly, battery installation, motherboard assembly, camera installation, shell lamination, and final inspection and packaging.

Solution Advantages

  • Precision assembly ensures product quality
  • Automated vision inspection improves accuracy
  • Multi-model flexible switching
  • Efficient packaging system
  • Turnkey project service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, and after-sales service.
